title: Uppāde
text: 1. Sāvatthi || || 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti nāññatra Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa || || 3. Katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyam paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyani bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti nāññatra Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassāti || ||
